title: Formula for a placed configuration
statement: Let $k,l$ be natural numbers, let $S,H$ be types, and let a placement consist of an injection from the $k$ source tape indices into the $l$ host tape indices and a selector that identifies the source index at each occupied host index. Given a state map $S\to H$, host tape contents and head positions, and a source configuration $c$, the placed configuration has state obtained by mapping the state of $c$, the same input-head position and output as $c$, and on each host tape uses the contents and head position of the selected source tape when occupied, or the supplied host contents and head position otherwise.
hypotheses_covered: A placement with an injection and an exact selector
